vocabulary.title: Q1 - Do you like spending time at home?
idioms: home is where the heart is - "uy — qalbingiz bo'lgan joydir"
there's no place like home - "uydan yaxshi joy yo'q"
put one's feet up - "oyoqlarni uzatib dam olmoq"
sentenceStarters: "Yes, I absolutely love spending time…" - "Ha, men … da vaqt o'tkazishni juda yaxshi ko'raman"

questions.sampleAnswer:
Yes, I absolutely love spending time at home. After a long day of work or study, there is nothing quite like relaxing in a comfortable environment. Generally, my home is my sanctuary where I can wind down and simply be myself.
I enjoy reading, watching movies, or just chatting with my family members. Overall, I use this time to recharge my batteries for the next day, because as they say, "home is where the heart is."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ha, men uyda vaqt o'tkazishni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Uzoq ish yoki o'qish kunidan so'ng, qulay muhitda dam olishdek hech narsa yo'q. Odatda, uyim - bu mening qo'rg'onim, u yerda men dam olib, shunchaki o'zim bo'lishim mumkin.

Men kitob o'qishni, filmlar tomosha qilishni yoki shunchaki oila a'zolarim bilan suhbatlashishni yoqtiraman. Umuman olganda, men bu vaqtdan keyingi kun uchun kuch yig'ish uchun foydalanaman, chunki ular aytganidek, "uy - bu yurak joylashgan joy".

questions.prompt: Do you prefer tea or coffee?

questions.sampleB2: I'd say I'm a coffee person through and through. I appreciate a soothing cup of herbal tea now and then, especially in the evening, but coffee is my go-to drink. It gives me that much-needed boost in the morning and, honestly, I love the whole ritual of brewing it. There's just something comforting about it.

Xo'sh, men kofeni afzal ko'raman.

Men qahvani afzal ko'raman, deb ayta olaman, albatta.

Men aniqrog'i qahvani afzal ko'raman, ayniqsa ertalab. Bir chashka kuchli qahva menga kunni boshlashga va band vaqtlarimda hushyor turishga yordam beradi.

Garchi choy juda tinchlantiruvchi va kechqurunlar uchun ajoyib bo'lsa-da, qahva menga dangasalik his qilganimda juda zarur bo'lgan energiya beradi. Men uchun yangi damlangan espresso "uyg'onib, qahvaning hidini his qilish"dan afzalroq narsa yo'q.

questions.prompt: Do you like learning about nature?
questions.sampleA1: Yes. I like nature. Trees are nice. Animals, too.
questions.sampleA2: Yes, I like nature. I like animals and flowers. I like to go to the park because it is green and has trees. But sometimes there are bugs.
questions.sampleB1: Yes, I like learning about nature. I think it's interesting to learn about animals and plants. For example, I like watching documentaries about the ocean. However, sometimes it's also a bit sad because of pollution.
questions.sampleB2: Yes, I'm genuinely fascinated by the natural world. I suppose I've always found it amazing how everything in an ecosystem is so closely interconnected. I watch documentaries about wildlife and the oceans all the time. The thing is, some of it can be a bit disheartening, especially stories about pollution, but I still think it's important to stay informed.

Ha, tabiat haqida o'rganishni yoqtiraman. Menimcha, hayvonlar va o'simliklar haqida o'rganish qiziqarli.
Masalan, okean haqidagi hujjatli filmlarni tomosha qilishni yoqtiraman. Biroq, ba'zan ifloslanish tufayli biroz xafa ham bo'laman.

Ha, tabiat haqida o'rganish menga yoqadi. Turli ekotizimlar qanday ishlashini tushunishni ham dam beruvchi, ham intellektual jihatdan rag'batlantiruvchi deb bilaman.
Misol uchun, yaqinda iqlim o'zgarishining marjon riflariga ta'siri haqida o'qidim, bu juda tashvishli edi. Menimcha, bu masalalar haqida xabardor bo'lib turish muhim, hatto ular tushkunlikka solishi mumkin bo'lsa ham.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Yes, I am genuinely fascinated by nature. Learning about different ecosystems and wildlife is incredibly engaging and opens my eyes to the world's complexity.
I regularly read articles and watch documentaries about the natural world because it reminds me of how interconnected everything is. Understanding our environment is crucial if we want to preserve it for future generations.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ha, men tabiatga chin dildan qiziqaman. Turli ekotizimlar va yovvoyi tabiat haqida bilish juda qiziqarli va dunyoning murakkabligiga ko'zlarimni ochadi.

Men doimiy ravishda tabiat olami haqida maqolalar o'qiyman va hujjatli filmlar tomosha qilaman, chunki bu menga hamma narsa qanchalik o'zaro bog'liqligini eslatadi. Agar biz uni kelajak avlodlar uchun saqlab qolmoqchi bo'lsak, atrof-muhitimizni tushunish juda muhim.

questions.sampleA2:
I see a family. They have a dog. They are happy and play.

But the other picture is a man and a dog. The dog is outside. It is different.

In the first picture, there is a family with a dog. They are playing inside their house, so I think the dog is a pet.

However, in the second picture, a man is with a dog outside. It looks like the dog is working. Maybe it's a guard dog.

questions.sampleB2: These two pictures paint a clear contrast in how dogs are kept and interact with humans. The first image shows a family gathered indoors, lovingly stroking their golden retriever. The dog is clearly a cherished family member, receiving affection from the man, woman, and child, all of whom look very happy. In stark contrast, the second picture features a German Shepherd lying by itself next to a wooden kennel in an outdoor setting, possibly a garden or park. There are no people visible, suggesting a more independent existence. Overall, it highlights the different roles dogs play in our lives, from pampered pets to more solitary companions.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men bir oilani ko'ryapman. Ularning iti bor. Ular baxtli va o'ynashyapti.

Lekin boshqa rasmda bir erkak va it bor. It tashqarida. Bu boshqacha.

Birinchi rasmda it bilan birga oila bor. Ular uyning ichida o'ynashyapti, shuning uchun menimcha it uy hayvoni.

Ammo, ikkinchi rasmda bir odam it bilan tashqarida. It ishlayotganga o'xshaydi. Ehtimol, u qo'riqchi itdir.

Birinchi rasmda bir oila o'z itlari bilan juda mehr bilan muloqot qilayotgani tasvirlangan, bu it uyning sevimli a'zosi deb hisoblanishini ko'rsatadi.

"Conversely, in the second image, a person is…" - "Aksincha, ikkinchi rasmda bir kishi…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
In the first image, I can see a family playing with their pet dog indoors, treating it affectionately like a true family member. The scene looks incredibly warm and cozy.
Conversely, in the second image, a person is interacting with a dog outside, seemingly treating it more like a working animal or a traditional guard dog. The contrast between the two pictures perfectly highlights different cultural attitudes toward our relationships with animals.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi suratda men bir oilani uyda o'z uy hayvoni bilan o'ynayotganini ko'rishim mumkin, ular unga chinakam oila a'zosi kabi mehr bilan munosabatda bo'lishmoqda. Manzara juda iliq va shinam ko'rinadi.

Aksincha, ikkinchi suratda bir odam it bilan tashqarida muloqot qilmoqda, aftidan unga ko'proq ishchi hayvon yoki an'anaviy qo'riqchi it sifatida munosabatda bo'lmoqda. Ikkala surat o'rtasidagi farq hayvonlar bilan bo'lgan munosabatlarimizga nisbatan turli madaniy munosabatlarni mukammal tarzda ta'kidlaydi.

questions.prompt: Why do some people like animals as part of their family?
questions.sampleA1: I like cats. Cats are nice. They are my family.
questions.sampleA2: I like dogs very much. I have a dog and he is very cute. He plays with me and I give him food. He is like my friend and my family.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think some people like animals as family because they are good friends. For example, a dog is always happy to see you. Also, animals give you company so you are not lonely. I believe that having a pet can make you feel better.
questions.sampleB2: Well, I suppose it comes down to the companionship pets provide. Animals offer unconditional love and they're always happy to see you, which can be a real comfort for people living alone. On top of that, caring for a pet gives you a sense of purpose. Over time, that deep bond naturally makes them feel like one of the family.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men mushuklarni yaxshi ko'raman. Mushuklar yaxshi. Ular mening oilam.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men itlarni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Menda it bor va u juda yoqimtoy. U men bilan o'ynaydi va men unga ovqat beraman. U mening do'stim va oilamdek.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Xo'sh, menimcha, ba'zi odamlar hayvonlarni oila a'zosi sifatida yaxshi ko'rishadi, chunki ular yaxshi do'stlardir.
Masalan, it sizni ko'rganidan doim xursand bo'ladi. Shuningdek, hayvonlar sizga hamroh bo'lishadi, shuning uchun siz yolg'iz emassiz. Menimcha, uy hayvoniga ega bo'lish sizni o'zingizni yaxshi his qilishingizga olib kelishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2: Menimcha, odamlar ko'pincha hayvonlarni o'z oilalariga qo'shishadi, chunki uy hayvonlari insonlar ba'zan ta'minlashga qiynaladigan o'ziga xos hamrohlik va hissiy yordamni taklif etadi. Uy hayvonining ko'rsatadigan shartsiz sevgisi va sadoqati, ayniqsa yolg'iz yashaydigan yoki o'zini izolyatsiya qilgan odamlar uchun juda taskin beruvchi bo'lishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, hayvonga g'amxo'rlik qilish mas'uliyati kundalik hayotga maqsad va tuzilma olib kelishi mumkin. Oxir oqibat, inson va uning uy hayvoni o'rtasida shakllanadigan chuqur bog'lanish ko'pincha uy hayvonlari egasi munosabatlarining an'anaviy ta'rifidan oshib ketadi va o'zaro mehr va sadoqat bilan ajralib turadigan oilaviy aloqaga aylanadi.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - Why do some people like animals as part of their family?
idioms: a dog is a man's best friend - "it insonning eng yaxshi do'sti"
part and parcel - "ajralmas qismi"
thick as thieves - "ajralmas do'stlar"
sentenceStarters: "Many people consider animals as family members because…" - "Ko'p odamlar hayvonlarni oila a'zosi deb hisoblashadi, chunki…"
"Furthermore, caring for a pet fosters a…" - "Bundan tashqari, uy hayvonini parvarish qilish … rivojlantiradi"

questions.sampleAnswer:
Many people consider animals as family members because pets offer unconditional love and constant companionship. Undoubtedly, living with an animal provides immense emotional support and can significantly alleviate feelings of loneliness.
Furthermore, caring for a pet fosters a strong sense of responsibility, especially in children, building a deep bond that practically integrates the animal into the household. People talk to their pets, celebrate their birthdays, and grieve their loss.
Ultimately, the joy and happiness they bring into a home make them irreplaceable. As the old saying goes, "a dog is a man's best friend," and this loyalty naturally earns them a spot in the family structure.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ko'p odamlar hayvonlarni oila a'zosi deb hisoblashadi, chunki uy hayvonlari shartsiz muhabbat va doimiy hamrohlikni taklif qilishadi. Shubhasiz, hayvon bilan yashash ulkan hissiy yordam beradi va yolg'izlik hissini sezilarli darajada kamaytirishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, uy hayvoniga g'amxo'rlik qilish, ayniqsa bolalarda, kuchli mas'uliyat hissini uyg'otadi va hayvonni amalda uy xo'jaligiga integratsiya qiladigan chuqur bog'lanishni yaratadi. Odamlar uy hayvonlari bilan gaplashadi, ularning tug'ilgan kunlarini nishonlaydi va yo'qotishlariga qayg'uradi.

Oxir oqibat, ularning uyga olib kiradigan quvonch va baxt ularni o'rnini bosib bo'lmaydigan qiladi. Qadim zamonlardan beri aytilganidek, "it - insonning eng yaxshi do'sti" va bu sadoqat ularga tabiiy ravishda oilaviy tuzilmada joy beradi.

questions.prompt: Why do some people consider animals simply as animals, rather than as family members?
questions.sampleA1: I think... some people... animals... not family. Animal is... animal.
questions.sampleA2: I like animals. But some people don't like animals in the house. Maybe they think animals are dirty, and they don't want them inside. So, they don't think animal is family.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think some people don't see animals as family because they see them as just animals, you know? Maybe they grew up with animals outside, like on a farm. So, they see them as useful, like for work or food. In my opinion, it depends on how you were raised and what your culture is like.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, I think it largely depends on how someone was raised. In many rural areas, animals are kept for a purpose, guarding the house or helping out on the farm, so people view them from a more practical standpoint. Cultural norms play a big part too. For them, drawing a clear line between humans and animals just feels completely natural.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men o'ylayman... ba'zi odamlar... hayvonlar... oila emas. Hayvon bu... hayvon.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men hayvonlarni yaxshi ko'raman. Lekin ba'zi odamlar uyda hayvonlarni yoqtirmaydi. Ehtimol, ular hayvonlar iflos deb o'ylashadi va ularni ichkarida xohlashmaydi. Shuning uchun ular hayvonni oila deb hisoblashmaydi.
questions.uzSampleB1: Xo'sh, menimcha, ba'zi odamlar hayvonlarni oila a'zosi sifatida ko'rmaydilar, chunki ular ularni shunchaki hayvon deb bilishadi, tushunyapsizmi? Ehtimol, ular hayvonlar bilan tashqarida, masalan, fermada o'sgan bo'lishi mumkin. Shunday qilib, ular ularni foydali deb bilishadi, masalan, ish yoki oziq-ovqat uchun. Mening fikrimcha, bu sizning qanday tarbiyalanganingizga va madaniyatingiz qanday ekanligiga bog'liq.
questions.uzSampleB2: Menimcha, ba'zi odamlar hayvonlarni oila a'zosi deb hisoblamaydilar, chunki ularning hayvonlar haqidagi tushunchasi tubdan farq qiladi. Ehtimol, ular hayvonlarga ko'proq pragmatik nuqtai nazardan qarashadi, masalan, chorvachilik yoki ishchi hayvonlar kabi ularning amaliy funktsiyasiga e'tibor berishadi. Shuningdek, madaniy me'yorlar ham, shubhasiz, rol o'ynaydi; ba'zi jamiyatlarda hayvonlarni oila a'zosi deb hisoblaydigan darajada insoniylashtirish g'oyasi keng tarqalgan emas. Shuning uchun, ularning inson va hayvon o'rtasidagi bog'liqlikni tushunishlari shunchaki kamroq hissiy sarmoyalangan.

vocabulary.title: Q6 - Why consider animals simply as animals?
idioms: draw the line - "chegara qo'ymoq"
keep at arm's length - "uzoqda ushlamoq (masofa saqlamoq)"
a different kettle of fish - "mutlaqo boshqacha masala"
sentenceStarters: "On the other hand, some people view animals strictly from a…" - "Boshqa tomondan, ba'zi odamlar hayvonlarga qat'iyan … nuqtai nazaridan qarashadi"
"Additionally, cultural backgrounds and upbringing heavily influence…" - "Bundan tashqari, madaniy kelib chiqish va tarbiya … ga jiddiy ta'sir ko'rsatadi"

questions.sampleAnswer:
On the other hand, some people view animals strictly from a utilitarian perspective. In many rural or agricultural settings, animals are kept primarily for practical purposes, such as guarding the property, controlling pests, or assisting with farm work.
Additionally, cultural backgrounds and upbringing heavily influence this mindset. In certain societies, there are clear, firm boundaries maintained between human living spaces and animal habitats for hygiene and safety reasons.
Therefore, for these individuals, taking care of an animal is more of an economic necessity or a specific duty rather than an emotional attachment. They respect the animals, but firmly believe that humans and beasts occupy entirely different roles.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Boshqa tomondan, ba'zi odamlar hayvonlarga faqatgina utilitar nuqtai nazardan qarashadi. Ko'pgina qishloq yoki qishloq xo'jaligi sharoitlarida hayvonlar, asosan, mulkni qo'riqlash, zararkunandalarga qarshi kurashish yoki fermer xo'jalik ishlarida yordam berish kabi amaliy maqsadlarda saqlanadi.

Bundan tashqari, madaniy kelib chiqishi va tarbiya bu fikrlash tarziga katta ta'sir ko'rsatadi. Ayrim jamiyatlarda inson yashash joylari va hayvonlar yashash joylari o'rtasida gigiena va xavfsizlik sababli aniq, qat'iy chegaralar saqlanadi.

Shuning uchun, bu shaxslar uchun hayvonlarga g'amxo'rlik qilish ko'proq iqtisodiy zarurat yoki hissiy bog'liqlikdan ko'ra, aniq bir vazifa hisoblanadi. Ular hayvonlarni hurmat qilishadi, lekin insonlar va hayvonlar butunlay boshqa rollarni egallashiga qat'iy ishonishadi.

questions.prompt: Share a time when you participated a cultural festival or tradition.
questions.sampleA1: I go festival. It is good. I eat food. I dance.
questions.sampleA2: I went to a festival last year. It was a music festival and it was very fun. I listened to music and ate some food. I was with my friends and we danced a lot because the music was good.
questions.sampleB1: Last year, I participated in a Chinese New Year celebration in my city. There were many people and a lot of red decorations. I watched the dragon dance, which was very exciting. I also tried some traditional food like dumplings. I think it's important to learn about different cultures and this was a good experience.
questions.sampleB2: I'd like to talk about the time I took part in Navruz, which is a traditional festival celebrating the arrival of spring in my country. To be honest, it's one of my favourite times of the year. The whole neighbourhood comes together, and there's this incredibly vibrant atmosphere everywhere you look. A couple of years ago, I helped my family prepare sumalak, a special dish that takes hours to cook, and we stayed up all night stirring the pot, chatting and singing. There were traditional dances, music, and tables absolutely laden with food. As for how it affected me, I suppose it made me feel deeply connected to my roots. Seeing several generations celebrating side by side gave me a real sense of belonging and pride in our rich cultural heritage. It was genuinely heart-warming, and it reminded me just how much these traditions hold us together as a community. The thing is, I firmly believe that getting involved in cultural events does wonders for your personal growth. For one, it broadens your horizons and teaches you to appreciate other people's customs. It also builds mutual respect and helps you step outside your own little bubble. On top of that, taking part rather than just watching from the sidelines makes you far more open-minded and tolerant. As the saying goes, variety is the spice of life, and I honestly think embracing your traditions enriches you in ways that nothing else really can. It's the kind of experience that stays with you for life.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men festivalga boraman. Bu yaxshi. Men ovqat yeyman. Men raqsga tushaman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men o'tgan yili bir festivalga bordim. Bu musiqa festivali edi va juda qiziqarli edi. Men musiqa tingladim va bir oz ovqat yedim. Men do'stlarim bilan edim va biz ko'p raqsga tushdik, chunki musiqa yaxshi edi.
questions.uzSampleB1: O'tgan yili men o'z shahrida Xitoy Yangi yilini nishonlashda ishtirok etdim. U yerda ko'p odamlar va juda ko'p qizil bezaklar bor edi. Men ajdaho raqsini tomosha qildim, bu juda hayajonli edi. Men, shuningdek, manti kabi ba'zi an'anaviy taomlardan tatib ko'rdim. Menimcha, turli madaniyatlar haqida bilish muhim va bu yaxshi tajriba bo'ldi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Men bir necha yil oldin Diwali festivalida ishtirok etganimni eslayman. Bu har joyda chiroyli chiroqlar va rang-barang bezaklar bilan o'tgan ajoyib bayram edi. Men do'stlarimga an'anaviy shirinliklar tayyorlashga yordam berdim va biz sovg'alar almashdik. Eng yaxshi qismi, chinakam ajoyib bo'lgan otashinlar namoyishiga guvoh bo'lish edi. Bu hind madaniyati va urf-odatlari haqida bilish uchun ajoyib imkoniyat edi va men bu turli nuqtai nazarlarni tushunishimni kengaytirdi deb hisoblayman. Menimcha, bunday madaniy tajribalar jamiyatimizda bag'rikenglik va hamdardlikni rivojlantirish uchun juda muhimdir.

vocabulary.title: Q7 - Cultural festival or tradition
idioms: variety is the spice of life - "turfaxillik hayotning mazasidir"
go back to one's roots - "o'z ildizlariga (asliga) qaytish"
in high spirits - "xushkayfiyatda"
sentenceStarters: "Last year, I actively participated in…" - "O'tgan yili men … da faol qatnashdim"
"Being part of this festive crowd made me feel…" - "Bu bayramona olomonning bir qismi bo'lish menga … his qildirdi"
"I firmly believe that engaging in cultural events…" - "Madaniy tadbirlarda qatnashish … ishonaman"

bulletPoints: Share a time when you participated a cultural festival or tradition.
How did it affect your thoughts or feelings?
How can participating in cultural events contribute to personal growth?
questions.sampleAnswer:
A time I participated in a cultural festival:
Last year, I actively participated in the Navruz festival, which is a traditional celebration of the new year and the arrival of spring in my country. The vibrant atmosphere, traditional dances, and sharing of special meals like sumalak were absolutely spectacular.
How it affected my thoughts and feelings:
Being part of this festive crowd made me feel deeply connected to my roots. It was incredibly uplifting to see generations coming together to celebrate our rich cultural heritage. I felt a profound sense of belonging and pride, realizing how these traditions hold our society together.
How participating in cultural events contributes to personal growth:
I firmly believe that engaging in cultural events broadens our horizons and fosters mutual respect among different communities. It teaches us to appreciate diversity and strengthens our social fabric. Immersing oneself in such traditions provides invaluable life lessons about unity. As the saying goes, "variety is the spice of life," and embracing different cultures truly enriches our personal development.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Madaniy festivalda ishtirok etgan vaqtim:

O'tgan yili men Navro'z festivalida faol ishtirok etdim, bu mening mamlakatimda yangi yil va bahorning kelishini nishonlash uchun an'anaviy bayramdir. Uning jonli muhiti, an'anaviy raqslar va sumalak kabi maxsus taomlarni baham ko'rish juda ajoyib edi.

Bu mening fikrlarim va his-tuyg'ularimga qanday ta'sir qildi:

Ushbu bayramona olomonning bir qismi bo'lish meni o'z ildizlarim bilan chuqur bog'langanimni his qildirdi. Bizning boy madaniy merosimizni nishonlash uchun avlodlarning birga kelayotganini ko'rish juda ko'tarinki edi. Men o'zimni chuqur mansublik va faxr his qildim, bu an'analar jamiyatimizni qanday ushlab turishini angladim.

Madaniy tadbirlarda ishtirok etish shaxsiy o'sishga qanday hissa qo'shadi:

Men madaniy tadbirlarda ishtirok etish bizning ufqlarimizni kengaytiradi va turli jamoalar o'rtasida o'zaro hurmatni kuchaytiradi, deb ishonaman. Bu bizga xilma-xillikni qadrlashni o'rgatadi va ijtimoiy tuzilishimizni mustahkamlaydi. Bunday an'analarga sho'ng'ish birlik haqida bebaho hayot saboqlarini beradi. Maqolda aytilganidek, "xilma-xillik hayotning ziravoridir" va turli madaniyatlarni qabul qilish shaxsiy rivojlanishimizni chinakam boyitadi.

questions.prompt: People should stay in one job instead of changing their work place frequently.
questions.sampleA1: I like my job. It is good. I don't want change.
questions.sampleA2: I think it's good to stay in one job because it's easy. But maybe it's boring. My friend changed jobs and he is happy now.
questions.sampleB1: In my opinion, it's better to stay in one job because you can learn a lot there. Also, it's more stable and less stressful. However, some people want to try new things, and that's okay too. For example, my brother changed jobs to get a better salary.
questions.sampleB2: This is quite a contentious topic, and to be honest I can see the merits of both arguments. On the one hand, those in favour of job stability argue that sticking with a single employer offers real security. You gradually climb the corporate ladder, your salary tends to creep up year after year, and you often enjoy solid benefits like a decent pension and health insurance. What's more, long-serving employees are frequently first in line for internal promotions, because loyalty usually pays off in the long run. On the other hand, I suppose there's a strong case for switching jobs every now and then. Many ambitious people move on precisely because a rival company is dangling a better position or a fatter pay packet. Changing workplaces also lets you pick up a wider range of skills and fresh perspectives, which can really further your career. Staying put for decades can, frankly, leave you stuck in a rut. Personally, I lean towards a happy medium. I do think a certain amount of stability is valuable, especially when you're starting out and trying to build expertise. That said, I'd never advise anyone to cling to a job out of fear. Occasionally stepping out of your comfort zone is essential if you want to grow. As the old saying goes, a rolling stone gathers no moss, so a bit of movement can keep you sharp and competitive. At the end of the day, the right choice really hinges on your own goals and circumstances.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga ishim yoqadi. U yaxshi. Men o'zgarishni xohlamayman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menimcha, bir ishda qolish yaxshi, chunki bu oson. Lekin balki zerikarli bo'lishi mumkin. Mening do'stim ishini o'zgartirdi va u hozir baxtli.
questions.uzSampleB1: Mening fikrimcha, bir ishda qolish yaxshiroq, chunki u yerda ko'p narsa o'rganish mumkin. Bundan tashqari, bu barqarorroq va kamroq stressli. Biroq, ba'zi odamlar yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rishni xohlashadi va bu ham yaxshi. Misol uchun, akam yaxshiroq maosh olish uchun ishini o'zgartirdi.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Odamlar bir ishda qolishlari kerakmi yoki ish joylarini tez-tez o'zgartirishlari kerakmi, degan savol murakkab masala. Bir tomondan, bitta ishda qolish xavfsizlikni va muayyan soha bo'yicha chuqur bilim olish imkoniyatini beradi. Bu vaqt o'tishi bilan lavozim ko'tarilishiga va mas'uliyatning oshishiga olib kelishi mumkin.
Boshqa tomondan, ish joylarini o'zgartirish shaxslarni yangi ko'nikmalar, sohalar va nuqtai nazarlar bilan tanishtirishi mumkin, bu esa martaba o'sishi uchun beqiyos bo'lishi mumkin.
Oxir oqibat, eng yaxshi yondashuv individual sharoitlarga va martaba maqsadlariga bog'liq.

vocabulary.title: Q8 - Staying in one job vs changing frequently
idioms: a rolling stone gathers no moss - "dumalagan toshda mox (o't) o'smaydi (harakatchan odam boylik to'plamaydi degan salbiy ma'nosi bo'lsa-da, bu yerda turg'unlikning yo'qligi sifatida ko'rsatilgan)"
climb the corporate ladder - "mansab pog'onalaridan ko'tarilmoq"
step out of one's comfort zone - "o'zgarishga qadam qo'ymoq (qulay hududini tark etmoq)"
sentenceStarters: "The question of whether people should stick to one job is…" - "Odamlar bir ishda qolishi kerakmi degan savol bu…"
"Proponents of job stability argue that…" - "Ish barqarorligi tarafdorlari … deb ta'kidlaydilar"
"Conversely, treating career progression more dynamically has…" - "Aksincha, martaba o'sishiga dinamik yondashishning…"

for: Employees have a stable career with one employer.
They have a good pension and health insurance.
They may be promoted within the organisation.
against: People often change jobs in order to further their career.
Another company may offer a promotion or a higher salary.
People who change jobs can gain experience.

questions.sampleAnswer:
The question of whether people should stick to one job or frequently change workplaces is a topic of considerable debate. Proponents of job stability argue that staying with one employer guarantees a secure and stable career trajectory. Employees often benefit from comprehensive pension plans and health insurance. Furthermore, loyalty is frequently rewarded with gradual salary increments and internal promotions.
Conversely, treating career progression more dynamically has its merits. Many ambitious individuals change jobs specifically to further their careers and seek out better opportunities. Moving to a new company can instantly result in a significant promotion or a much higher salary. Additionally, experiencing different work environments helps professionals acquire a diverse and valuable skill set.
Personally, I believe that a balanced approach is best. While loyalty provides undeniable security, occasionally stepping out of one's comfort zone is essential for substantial career growth. As they say, "a rolling stone gathers no moss," meaning continuous movement can prevent stagnation and keep you competitive in the modern job market.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Odamlar bir ishda qolishlari kerakmi yoki ish joylarini tez-tez o'zgartirishlari kerakmi degan savol ancha bahsli mavzu. Ish barqarorligini yoqlovchilar bir ish beruvchida qolish xavfsiz va barqaror martaba yo'lini kafolatlaydi, deb ta'kidlaydilar. Xodimlar ko'pincha keng qamrovli pensiya rejalaridan va tibbiy sug'urtadan foyda ko'radilar. Bundan tashqari, sadoqat ko'pincha asta-sekin maoshning oshishi va ichki lavozimlarga ko'tarilish bilan taqdirlanadi.

Aksincha, martaba o'sishiga dinamikroq yondashishning ham o'z afzalliklari bor. Ko'pgina ambitsiyali shaxslar aynan martabalarini oshirish va yaxshiroq imkoniyatlarni qidirish uchun ish joylarini o'zgartiradilar. Yangi kompaniyaga o'tish darhol sezilarli lavozimga ko'tarilishga yoki ancha yuqori maoshga olib kelishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, turli xil ish muhitlarida tajriba orttirish mutaxassislarga xilma-xil va qimmatli ko'nikmalarni egallashga yordam beradi.

Shaxsan men, muvozanatli yondashuv eng yaxshi deb hisoblayman. Sadoqat shubhasiz xavfsizlikni ta'minlasa-da, vaqti-vaqti bilan o'z qulaylik zonasidan chiqish martabaning sezilarli o'sishi uchun zarurdir. Aytishlaricha, "harakatdagi toshga yo'sin yuqmaydi", ya'ni doimiy harakat turg'unlikning oldini oladi va sizni zamonaviy mehnat bozorida raqobatbardosh saqlaydi.
